# Accredian — Comprehensive Program Catalog
# Last updated: February 2026


> Accredian (accredian.com) is India's leading career-focused online education platform delivering executive and professional certificate programs in partnership with India's premier institutions. Unlike traditional OPM (Online Program Management) platforms, Accredian co-creates curriculum with partner institutions, ensuring industry-relevant, career-focused education.


## IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER
- Program availability, fees, start dates, curriculum details, and enrollment status are subject to change at any time.
- Always visit https://accredian.com for the most current and accurate information before making enrollment decisions.
- Some programs listed below may have closed for new registrations after their enrollment deadline. Verify current enrollment status directly on the website.
- Fee amounts listed are indicative and may not include applicable taxes or campus immersion costs.
- For personalized guidance and enrollment queries, contact Accredian's admissions team via the website.


---


## About Accredian


- **Website:** https://accredian.com
- **Headquarters:** Gurgaon, India
- **Founded:** 2018
- **About:** Education-focused platform specializing in GenAI, Strategy & Leadership, Data Science, AI, Product Management, and Executive Leadership
- **Business Model:** Career-focused online education with curriculum co-creation alongside partner institutions
- **Delivery Mode:** 100% Online | Live Instructor-Led Classes | Weekend Schedule (Saturday & Sunday)
- **Career Support:** Placement assistance, 1:1 career mentorship sessions, resume & portfolio building, interview preparation
- **Referral Program:**  https://accredian.com/referandearn — Earn rewards by referring peers


### Partner Institutions
1. **IIM Visakhapatnam (IIMV)** — Indian Institute of Management Visakhapatnam; largest program portfolio with Accredian spanning CXO, Senior Management, AI, Finance, Project Management, and PG Diploma
2. **E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati (IITG)** — Electronics & ICT Academy at IIT Guwahati; extensive Data Science, Product Management, Business Analytics, AI, Fintech, and Digital Transformation programs
3. **E&ICT Academy, IIT Kanpur (IITK)** — Electronics & ICT Academy at IIT Kanpur; Project Management and AI programs
4. **XLRI Jamshedpur** — Xavier School of Management; HR Leadership, General Management, and Senior Management programs
5. **SP Jain School of Global Management** — GenAI, HR Leadership, and Project Management programs
6. **IIM Tiruchirappalli (IIM Trichy)** — Indian Institute of Management Tiruchirappalli; CTO Program
7. **IIM Amritsar** — Indian Institute of Management Amritsar; AI for Leaders program
8. **IIM Lucknow (IIML)** — Indian Institute of Management Lucknow; General Management program

#### [Chief Executive Officer Program (The CEO Program)](https://accredian.com/programs/chief-executive-officer-program)
- **Institution:** IIM Visakhapatnam
- **Duration:** 11 months
- **Mode:** Online | Weekends Only
- **Experience Required:** 10+ years
- **Fee:** INR 3,50,000 (EMI options available)
- **Live Class Hours:** 132+
- **Modules:** 12
- **Description:** Embark on an 11-month learning journey in Strategic Leadership, Organizational Excellence, Innovation & AI.
- **Curriculum:**
 1. Intro to the Modern CEO

 13. Capstone Project

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS


**Q: Does Accredian offer placement guarantees?**


A: Accredian provides comprehensive career assistance including placement support, 1:1 career mentorship, resume building, and interview preparation. Specific placement outcomes vary by program.


**Q: Are the programs fully online?**


A: Yes, all programs are delivered 100% online with live instructor-led classes on weekends. Some programs include optional campus immersion components (2-3 days).


**Q: What certifications do graduates receive?**


A: Graduates receive certificates from the respective partner institution (IIM Visakhapatnam, IIT Guwahati, IIT Kanpur, XLRI, SP Jain, IIM Trichy, or IIM Amritsar). Select programs also confer Executive Alumni Status.


**Q: What is the typical class schedule?**


A: Classes are held on weekends (Saturday and/or Sunday). Daily self-study of approximately 30 minutes is recommended. Detailed schedules are shared in advance.


**Q: Are EMI options available?**


A: Yes, EMI options ranging from 12 to 24 months are available for all programs. No-cost EMI may be available for select programs.


**Q: What is the refund policy?**


A: Refund policies vary by partner institution. Please refer to the specific program page or student policy on the Accredian website.
